page_title: INT 4-0 COM | Inter v Como 06/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+3' Marco Di Bello is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+2' Nico Paz (Como) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
90' 3 additional min. will be played.
90' One of the players from Inter times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
89' Wonderful movement by Como. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
88' Manuel Akanji (Inter) picks up a yellow card for an infringement.

86' 4 - 0 Federico Dimarco sends a precise lofted cross into the box. Carlos Augusto (Inter) latches on to it and finishes with a quick shot into the top right corner. The goalkeeper had no chance. The score changes to 4:0.
85' Cristian Chivu has decided to make a change. Andy Diouf (Inter) replaces Nicolo Barella.
85' Substitution. Lautaro Martinez is replaced by Petar Sucic (Inter).
84' The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Inter.
83' Como will look to benefit from a promising free kick near the touchline.
82' Here is a change. Jesus Rodriguez is going off and Cesc Fabregas gives the last tactical orders to Nicolas-Gerrit Kuhn (Como).
82' Maximo Perrone will be replaced by Maxence Caqueret (Como).

81' 3 - 0 The ball rebounds and arrives at the feet of Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) just outside the box. He doesn't think twice and fires a brilliant shot into the bottom left corner. His attempt was beyond the reach of Jean Butez. 3:0.
80' Anastasios Douvikas (Como) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
77' Cristian Chivu prepares a substitution. Marcus Thuram is replaced by Francesco Pio Esposito (Inter).
77' Substitution. Carlos Augusto (Inter) replaces Luis Henrique.
76' Jesus Rodriguez (Como) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Yann Sommer, who smothers the ball.

73' This was a piece of cake for Jean Butez. Lautaro Martinez (Inter) found himself some space after latching on to a pass, but his strike only went low to the middle of the goal and into the gloves of the prepared keeper.
73' Federico Dimarco (Inter) is penalised for holding. Marco Di Bello signals a set piece.
71' Here's the change. Piotr Zielinski (Inter) leaves the pitch and Henrikh Mkhitaryan comes on as a substitute.

70' Nico Paz (Como) collects a wonderful lead pass and creates some space to smash the ball goalwards from long range. His shot goes painfully wide of the left post! The ball goes out of play and Inter will have a goal kick.
67' The resulting set piece from Como is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

67' Nico Paz (Como) darts to the edge of the box to meet the ball from the free kick and sends a header towards the middle of the target. One of the defending players gets in its way and blocks it. The ball goes out for a corner. Como can continue in their attacking effort.
64' Federico Dimarco (Inter) has a goal ruled out for offside!
63' The Inter players are exchanging some short passes.
59' 2 - 0 Marcus Thuram (Inter) scores! He finds himself some space inside the box after a cross from the corner kick and blasts the ball into the net. His effort went into the top right corner.
59' Inter will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
59' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Inter will have a chance to score from a corner kick.

57' Yann Sommer makes a brilliant save! Maximo Perrone (Como) easily weaves through the defence and unleashes a shot from just outside of the box. His effort goes towards the bottom right corner but is saved by the keeper!
53' The ball goes out of play and Inter will have a goal kick.
49' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) produces a cross from the resulting free kick far from the goal, but there's no one to really attack the ball and the goalkeeper gathers easily.
48' Como concede a free kick after one of their players holds onto an opposition player. Inter get a free kick.
48' The ball is out of play. Como will have a throw-in.
46' Cesc Fabregas has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Assane Diao (Como) comes on the pitch for Jayden Addai.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Cesc Fabregas gives a chance to Mergim Vojvoda and Stefan Posch (Como) is off.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+3' Marco Di Bello has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Diego Carlos (Como) was quite harsh and Marco Di Bello didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
45+1' Jayden Addai (Como) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Maximo Perrone (Como) is cautioned by the referee.
43' Anastasios Douvikas (Como) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.
38' Jayden Addai (Como) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while heading towards goal with the ball.

37' Inter slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
35' Inter have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
32' Anastasios Douvikas comes onto the pitch after Alvaro Morata (Como) signals to the bench that he cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
32' The injury to Alvaro Morata (Como) looks like it might have ended his involvement in this match.
30' Alvaro Morata (Como) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
30' Alvaro Morata (Como) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Inter.
28' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
27' Jesus Rodriguez (Como) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Como will take a corner kick.
26' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. It's a throw-in for Inter.

23' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Como are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
19' Marcus Thuram (Inter) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
18' Como are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
16' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Como.
15' The free kick from long range, taken by Como, is intercepted by one of the defenders. Como win a corner.
14' Alvaro Morata (Como) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.

11' 1 - 0 Goal! Luis Henrique displays great vision and sends a pass to Lautaro Martinez (Inter), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the bottom left corner. The score is 1:0.
10' Nico Paz (Como) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
9' Jesus Rodriguez (Como) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
8' Como are enjoying a spell of pressure at the moment, but one of the defenders gets it clear.
5' A corner kick by Inter is thwarted by the well prepared Jean Butez (Como).
4' The corner is swung in but Inter can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away. Inter force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.

4' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Inter will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

1' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Inter.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Como will have the kick-off.
Marco Di Bello is the one to supervise the game today.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
